_note: Access classification rules. Processed by scripts/network/access.js. First matching rule wins.
_not_rideable: Conditions that make a way not rideable by bike.
_car_free: Conditions that mark a way as car-free (→ ride_class=path, lts=1, confidence=high).
_unpaved: Surface values that flag a way as unpaved (rideable by bike but not for skating).
_restricted_areas: OSM area tag pairs whose interior edges are rideable=restricted unless the way itself says bicycle=yes|designated|permissive. Requires data/osm/areas.ndjson from npm run network:extract-areas (not yet implemented — way-level tags cover the common cases).
